title: News Search decoded upstream GET request shape (auth omitted in fixtures)
description: Documented-shape schema, not an exhaustive wire validator. query values use reference types; headers are strings. Required broker secret is intentionally not required in offline fixtures. See coverage and source conflicts.

q.description: Search phrase; nonempty, at most 400 characters and 50 words where required. Place Search also accepts omission or an empty phrase.

search_lang.description: Preferred content language, not interface language. Codes identify languages; regional/script suffixes narrow the preference.

ui_lang.description: Language-region locale for presentation and metadata, not a translation request.

country.description: Result-country selection using the listed country codes; ALL means worldwide. For suggest/spellcheck it is a ranking hint, not a hard geographic boundary.

safesearch.description: Adult-content policy; endpoint-specific off/moderate/strict semantics are explained below.

count.description: Requested result ceiling, not a guaranteed number; Web applies it only to web.results, Context uses it for candidate selection.

offset.description: Zero-based PAGE number, not a row offset. Keep count fixed across pages; duplicate results can occur.

spellcheck.description: Allow upstream spelling changes before searching; inspect query.altered rather than pretending the original phrase was executed unchanged.

freshness.description: Page-date filter: pd=24 hours, pw=7 days, pm=31 days, py=365 days, or inclusive-looking start/end syntax YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD (boundary inclusivity unspecified). Empty means no age filter.

extra_snippets.description: Enable up to five additional alternative excerpts per result; boolean meaning, serialized as true/false in GET despite reference string type.

goggles.description: One inline ruleset or registered hosted ruleset URL, or up to three such values; changes ranking/filtering rather than searching a different index.

include_fetch_metadata.description: Ask for fetch provenance/timestamps; availability and actual freshness are not guaranteed.

operators.description: Interpret operator syntax within q when true; false requests literal query treatment. Operator behavior remains experimental.

x-subscription-token.description: Required vendor secret header. Broker-only integration gate; not a provider argument or fixture value.

api-version.description: Date-form API version YYYY-MM-DD; omission follows latest. Operator selects any explicit pin; old Context pipeline pin is 2026-02-06.

accept.description: application/json requests JSON; */* accepts the available representation. Provider fixes JSON.

cache-control.description: no-cache asks upstream to avoid cached content on a best-effort basis; no retention or origin-fetch guarantee.

user-agent.description: Originating agent/device description can change presentation; operator-owned, not caller-supplied arbitrary identity.

accept-encoding.description: Compression negotiation shown as gzip in public examples; operator-only and deferred until bounded decompression behavior is verified.
